build.note: Ice time × production per 60 minutes, both recency-weighted and blended with a position average, then scaled by how many goals the opponent allows compared with the league. The model then turns this average into the chance of each count.

rows.goalie_assumption: Projected, not confirmed. Opposing goalie, Toronto Maple Leafs: likely Sergei Bobrovsky 51% (sv 0.889), Anthony Stolarz 38%, Artur Akhtyamov 10%.
rows.lineup_assumption: Participation required for action; current role and active lineup unconfirmed

sensitivity.assumption: Production/opportunity means ±10%; not a confidence interval

assessment.reason: The +225 price is longer than both the model's fair price near +184 and the devigged market, and low-end sensitivity still clears break-even. Any edge comes mainly from one longer quote rather than model disagreement.
assessment.model_case: The model projects about 0.44 assists in 15.5 projected minutes. Weakness: an 8-game sample leans on rookie position priors and shrinkage, with line and power-play assignment unverified. Recent repeated usage supports an expected role, not confirmed deployment.
assessment.price_case: The main 0.5 line at +225 breaks even near three winners in ten. The model sits only slightly above the market, so value depends on DraftKings being longer than the single comparison book. Two books is not broad consensus.
assessment.context_case: No Stenberg-specific reporting was supplied, so context is unverified. Toronto's listed defensive absences are mild background, and Toronto's starting goalie is still only projected.

qualitative_review.countercase: With only eight NHL games, the assist rate is mostly prior. If Stenberg plays bottom-six minutes or loses power-play time, the projection falls below the +225 break-even. Model and market nearly agree, so a single soft quote may be the whole edge and could move.
open_checks: Check Stenberg's line and power-play unit from morning skate or lineup reporting
Reconfirm that +225 is still available before puck drop

evidence.excerpt: Christopher Tanev (D); Upper Body; IR. Expected to be out until at least Oct 22
evidence.interpretation: If Toronto's defense is thinned, San Jose's chance creation could rise modestly. This is background only, not prop-specific support.
